app.description: Tracking of country spending and supporting documents: what was spent, when, where, for whom, and where the proof is.

nav.reservee_siege: This page is restricted to headquarters: you have been taken back to the dashboard.

layout.hors_ligne_texte: Check your network access: the data shown may be out of date and nothing you enter will be saved.

notifications.description: Budget thresholds, expenses to review and decisions that concern you.

pwa.note_connexion: Available as a desktop app on Windows and macOS: install it from Chrome or Edge to open it outside the browser.

ui.tronque_texte: Only {{affiches}} {{nom}} out of {{total}} are listed. Refine your search or contact headquarters.

auth.sous_titre: Sign in to access your scope.
auth.oubli: Forgot your password? Contact a headquarters administrator.
auth.acces_reserve: Access restricted to accounts opened by headquarters.
auth.intro: Country budget tracking, from the allocated budget down to the supporting document.

promesses.enveloppe_texte: Allocated, committed, spent and remaining budget, in real time.
promesses.justifiee_texte: Date, place, beneficiary and supporting document, for every amount.
promesses.trace_texte: A declared expense is final and every action is recorded.

mdp.a_remplacer_texte: Your password was set by headquarters: it has been passed around, and until it is replaced your actions do not commit you. The platform stays closed until then.
mdp.regles: At least 10 characters, neither too common nor purely numeric. It must be known to you alone.
mdp.non_identiques: The two entries do not match.

totp.aide: Enter the six-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
totp.code_requis: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
totp.plus_acces: I no longer have access to my app
totp.plus_acces_texte: Only a headquarters administrator can reset your two-factor authentication. Contact them: a new enrolment will be offered at your next sign-in.
totp.a_enroler_texte: A password alone is not enough to commit your signature. Link an authenticator app to your account: the platform stays closed until then.
totp.consigne: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
totp.secret_aide: This key will not be shown again: type it into the app if you cannot scan the code.
totp.aide_connexion: Only if you have enabled two-factor authentication.
totp.volontaire_texte: A one-time code will be added to your password at every sign-in. It is optional until headquarters requires it, and recommended for anyone who reviews or justifies expenses.

liste.description: A file carries an ORDER No. and groups the expenses and proofs of a single operation.

vide.aide_creer: Create a file to attach your expenses to it.

formulaire.description: The ORDER No. identifies the set of documents; it must be unique.

detail.introuvable_texte: This file does not exist or is outside your scope.
detail.lignes_description: Each line follows its own justification workflow.

vide.aide_ajouter: Add the expenses of this file before submitting it.

reouverture.description: The file and its lines return to draft; the country is notified and will have to submit it again. The reason is kept in the audit log.
reouverture.motif_placeholder: Document to replace, amount to correct…
reouverture.lignes_bloquantes: A line already justified or closed prevents reopening.

formulaire.description: What was spent, when, where and for whom. Headquarters will record what the supporting documents justify.
formulaire.date_requise: Enter the date and time of the expense.
formulaire.montant_requis: Enter the amount of the expense, in figures.
formulaire.montant_decaisse_requis: Enter the amount paid, in figures.
formulaire.autre_devise_aide: Enter the amount as it appears on the supporting document. The server converts it to {{devise}} at the rate of the expense date and freezes that rate: the figure will not change.

rejet.description_depense: The expense remains charged to the budget: the money is gone. The reason is mandatory and stays attached to the history.
rejet.description_dossier: The file remains charged to the budget: the money is gone. The reason is mandatory and stays attached to the history.
rejet.motif_requis: A rejection must state a reason.

justification.description_depense: The justified amount is the one the supporting documents attest. The server computes the gap with the expense.
justification.description_dossier: All the lines of the file will be marked as justified.
justification.montant_requis: Enter the justified amount, in figures.
justification.declaree: Declared expense: {{montant}}. By default, everything is justified.
justification.note_partiel: Note (mandatory if the amount is partial)
justification.note_placeholder: Invoice No. 123 for 80%, remainder without proof…

pieces.description: Attached to the file; each file carries its SHA-256 fingerprint.

vide.aide_deposer: Upload the invoice, receipt or discharge that attests the expense.
vide.aide_sans_piece: The file was declared without a supporting document.

depot.doublon: A file already present on this file is refused, unless it explicitly replaces an earlier version.
depot.trop_gros: The file weighs {{taille}}; the limit is {{limite}}.

controle.description: {{nom}} — a rejection must state a reason.
controle.motif_requis: A rejection must state a reason.

registre.description: Where the money went: every expense with its date, place, beneficiary — and the supporting document that attests it.
registre.sans_piece_one: {{count}} expense without proof on this page
registre.sans_piece_other: {{count}} expenses without proof on this page
registre.sans_piece_aide: A payment without a supporting document remains charged to the budget.

vide.aide: Widen the period or remove a filter.

budgets.description: Annual budgets per country, sub-budgets per project, team or manager, and reallocations.

conversion.texte: No known rate for {{devises}}: these amounts are excluded from the consolidated total rather than absorbed into it.

vide.pays_indication_siege: Allocate an annual budget to each country you track.
vide.pays_indication_pays: Headquarters has not allocated a budget to your scope yet.
vide.enveloppes_indication_siege: Allocate a budget to start tracking.

form.description: A sub-budget splits the country budget along a single dimension: a project, a team or a manager.
form.montant_requis: Enter the budget amount, in figures.

realloc.description: Transfers between budgets, justified and subject to approval.
realloc.vide_indication_siege: Request a transfer to move an amount from one budget to another.
realloc.vide_indication_pays: No transfer has been requested in your scope.
realloc.form_description: The transfer is carried out only once approved.
realloc.montant_requis: Enter the amount to transfer, in figures.
realloc.refus_description: A rejection must state a reason: the reason is kept in the history.
realloc.motif_requis: A rejection must state a reason.

pilotage.description_siege: Consolidation of all countries, converted into {{devise}}.
pilotage.description_pays: Spending and alerts for your scope.

conversion.texte: No known rate for {{devises}}: these amounts are excluded from the consolidated total.

pilotage.autres_alertes_one: {{count}} more alert — the most serious ones are shown first.
pilotage.autres_alertes_other: {{count}} more alerts — the most serious ones are shown first.

vide.pays_indication: Allocate a budget from the Budgets page to track spending.

pilotage.choisir_pays: Choose a country to display its breakdown by month, team, manager, project, category and expense title.

repartition.vide_indication: Change the year or the country to see a breakdown.

liste.description: Set the currency, the time zone and the assignments of each country.
liste.vide_indice_gestion: Add a country from the list of African ISO codes.

formulaire.description: Choose the country, then its currency and time zone.
formulaire.choix_requis: Choose a country from the list.
formulaire.note_afrique: The platform tracks the group's African subsidiaries. Countries already registered do not appear in this list.
formulaire.actif_aide: Once deactivated, the country remains readable but no longer appears in active lists.

fiche.introuvable_texte: This country does not exist or is not within your scope.
fiche.budget_nombre: The budget must be a number.

managers.vide_indice_gestion: Add a manager to assign expenses and a sub-budget to them.
managers.vide_indice: Headquarters has not assigned any manager to this country.
managers.aide_ajouter: Create the manager and assign them to this country.

beneficiaires.description: Who receives the money, or who the expense targets. The list belongs to the country.
beneficiaires.vide: No beneficiary. Add some to be able to link them to expenses.

historique.vide_texte: Assignment and configuration changes will appear here.

lignes.vide_indice: Click on “{{action}}” to create the first entry.

configuration.description: Platform settings, accounts, countries and permissions. Restricted to headquarters administrators.

general.parametres_texte: Server settings are read-only. The workflow policy below can be changed by headquarters and takes effect without a restart.
general.smtp_absent: No server — messages go to the logs

workflow.enregistree_texte: It applies to every expense from now on.
workflow.controle_obligatoire_aide: A submitted expense must first go through “Under review”.
workflow.avertir_sans_piece_aide: Flag the missing document at submission time.
workflow.jours_invalides: Enter a whole number of days, zero or more.
workflow.facteur_invalide: Enter a strictly positive decimal factor.
workflow.seuils_invalides: Invalid thresholds: {{valeurs}}. Enter whole percentages separated by commas.

utilisateurs.description: Roles and scopes. DM and DF are headquarters accounts that can be restricted to countries; the manager is a country account and sees only their own country.
utilisateurs.vide_aide: Create the headquarters accounts and those of the country managers.
utilisateurs.soi_meme: Another administrator has to do it.

form.description: The password set here is temporary: its holder will be asked to replace it.
form.pays_requis: A country account must be attached to at least one country.
form.mdp_requis: A temporary password is required to create an account.
form.email_aide: @innovpharma.net address: it names the account in the authenticator app.
form.role_aide: DM and DF are headquarters accounts that can be restricted to countries; the manager is a country account. The administrator (HR) and the super administrator see everything.
form.perimetre_aide_siege: Optional for a headquarters account: with no country ticked, it sees every country. Tick countries to restrict a DM or a DF.
form.perimetre_aide_pays: A manager is attached to at least one country.

utilisateurs.totp_reinit_description: The account will lose access to the platform until its holder links an authenticator app again. The action is recorded in the audit log.

pays.description: Functional identifier, currency, time zone. A country is never deleted: it is deactivated, so that its history stays readable.

taux.description: A rate is never edited: publish a new one, dated. Amounts already consolidated keep the rate of their date.
taux.vide_aide: Countries outside the XOF zone will not be consolidated as long as no rate exists.
taux.dialogue_description: How many XOF one unit of this currency is worth, and from when.
taux.taux_invalide: Enter a strictly positive decimal rate.

import.description: What comes in through a workbook arrives as a draft and then follows the same circuit as entered expenses. Simulate first: nothing is written while the workbook contains an error.
import.pays_aide: Required for a workbook without a COUNTRY column.
import.fichier_aide: Expense export or historical workbook, in .xlsx format.
import.simulation_aide: Checks the workbook and counts what would be created, without writing anything.
import.rien_ecrit: A workbook with errors is not imported: fix the reported lines, then try again.

audit.description: Who did what, when and from which address. Entries can neither be edited nor deleted.
audit.chargement_impossible: Unable to load the audit log
audit.vide_aide: The log fills up as actions are taken.

exports.audit_note: Every export is recorded in the audit log.
